title: Practice 1: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Summer is coming to an end.
exercises.why: **подходит** is the present tense (3rd person singular) of **подходить** (to fit (of an object, to match another object); to come up (to), to approach, to go up (to)) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **подойти**. present: я подхожу́ · ты подхо́дишь · он подхо́дит · мы подхо́дим · вы подхо́дите · они подхо́дят. — Wiktionary, «подходить» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**под-, подо-** — Approach. Antonym: от- Example: Он подошёл к девушке, чтобы спросить её номер. — He approached the girl to ask for her number. Prepositional phrases: к + dat.; до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. Мы подъезжаем к городу.» — DLI, Lesson 29.  The other choice: **отходит** (**отходить**) has the prefix от-, ото- — Withdrawal a short distance away.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Thus, the roots of motion verbs convey the lexical information of manner of movement, e.g. walking, crawling, running, whereas prefixes denote path, e.g. motion in and out of space. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.why: **отвезёт** is the future tense (3rd person singular) of **отвезти** (to take away (by vehicle), to drive away, to take (someone or something by vehicle)) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **отвозить**. future: я отвезу́ · ты отвезёшь · он отвезёт · мы отвезём · вы отвезёте · они отвезу́т. — Wiktionary, «отвезти» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**от-, ото-** — Withdrawal a short distance away. Antonym: под- Example: Мальчик отошёл от незнакомца, который предложил ему конфеты. — The boy stepped back from the stranger who had offered him candy. Prepositional phrases: от + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «Verbs of motion with the prefix от- denote moving away from an object, a place or a person and require the preposition от + genitive case: Я отхожу от автомобиля. Студент отходит от учителя. Грузовик отъезжает от магазина.» — DLI, Lesson 29.  «отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". Their most common meaning is: "to take an object (or person) to a certain place and leave it there". Thus:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  «Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". Their most common meaning is: "to take an object (or person) to a certain place and leave it there".» — DLI, Lesson 79.  Compare: «Я отвёз деньги в банк.» (I took (by vehicle) money to the bank.) — DLI, Lesson 79.  The other choice: **подвезёт** (**подвезти**) has the prefix под-, подо- — Approach.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Thus, the roots of motion verbs convey the lexical information of manner of movement, e.g. walking, crawling, running, whereas prefixes denote path, e.g. motion in and out of space. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

Antonym: под- Example: Мальчик отошёл от незнакомца, который предложил ему конфеты. — The boy stepped back from the stranger who had offered him candy. Prepositional phrases: от + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «Verbs of motion with the prefix от- denote moving away from an object, a place or a person and require the preposition от + genitive case: Я отхожу от автомобиля. Студент отходит от учителя. Грузовик отъезжает от магазина.» — DLI, Lesson 29.  «отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". Their most common meaning is: "to take an object (or person) to a certain place and leave it there". Thus:.» — DLI, Lesson 79.  «Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". Their most common meaning is: "to take an object (or person) to a certain place and leave it there".» — DLI, Lesson 79.  Compare: «Я отвёз деньги в банк.» (I took (by vehicle) money to the bank.) — DLI, Lesson 79.  The other choice: **подвозит** (**подвозить**) has the prefix под-, подо- — Approach.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom raised his glass to his lips.
exercises.why: **поднёс** is the past tense (masculine) of **поднести** (to bring, to carry (to); to offer, to present) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **подносить**. past: он поднёс · она поднесла́ · оно поднесло́ · они поднесли́. — Wiktionary, «поднести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**под-, подо-** — Approach. Antonym: от- Example: Он подошёл к девушке, чтобы спросить её номер. — He approached the girl to ask for her number. Prepositional phrases: к + dat.; до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. Мы подъезжаем к городу.» — DLI, Lesson 29.  The other choice: **отнёс** (**отнести**) has the prefix от-, ото- — Withdrawal a short distance away.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
